text:
olivia: Heads-up - automated artifact scan found vendor bundle encrypted with old wrap key 'onboard-v0' and a stray service-account JSON inside. vendor claims staging but SA references prod roles. tagging eng-security.

sec-bot: Alert: artifact-scan rule=old-wrap-key+sa-json fired for object=partner-bundles/partnerZ-2026-12-02.tgz (hits=1).

harper: Treat as prod-impact until we confirm. Immediate plan: pause vendor fetches, delete SA keys, apply temporary deny binding, and rewrap artifacts.

dev: I'll delete keys and apply deny. Snippets: 
```
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=partnerZ-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --format='value(name)'
for k in $(gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=partnerZ-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --format='value(name)'); do gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete "$k" --iam-account=partnerZ-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com || true; done
# quick deny
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member=serviceAccount:partnerZ-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles.editor || true
```

infra: I'll add a conditional bucket deny for partner IPs and schedule a KMS rewrap slot at 02:00 UTC to avoid quotas.

harper: Rewrap owner? Need signed manifest and checksum verification before vendor re-pulls. Also revoke any Vault tokens tied to that SA.

dev: I'll own rewrap. Plan: create new key version, re-encrypt archives at 5/min, publish manifest to s3://secure-analytics/rewrap/INC-7654321000/manifest.json. Throttle to avoid KMS QPS.

olivia: On timeline: vendor paused distribution. propose window: disable access now, delete keys + deny in 10m, rewrap start in 20m. vendor ok with that.

sec-bot: Incident created INC-7654321000 "vendor bundle old-wrapkey + sa json" priority=P1 assigned to eng-security.

dev: Rewrap started: 4 archives queued, throttle 5/min. Will post manifest link when done.

infra: Applied bucket deny for vendor IPs. Also added short-lived org-policy deny on the SA so it can't be used during rotation.

harper: Revoked Vault tokens associated with the SA and enforced require_mfa=true on reissue roles for 72h.

dev: Rewrap complete 4/4. Manifest uploaded and signed: s3://secure-analytics/rewrap/INC-7654321000/manifest.json (sha256 list included).

olivia: Verified checksums and vendor confirmed they removed old bundles and will only pull after verification. Closing containment. Follow-ups: update vendor onboarding checklist (forbid SA JSON), add pre-upload artifact scan in CI, and schedule a rotation drill next quarter. Assign postmortem to olivia+dev.

harper: Filing follow-up tickets now. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
